name: Button Beetle
script:
on poke:
  say 1; hop 8
end
on tick every 20:
  if rand(4) == 0 then walk to garden; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on near critter:
  face; say 2
end

name: Pebble Lantern
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; say 1; end

name: Teacup Chime
script:
on world breeze:
  sound ding; frame 2; say 1
end
on hour 15: sound ding; emit note; end
on poke: sound tune; emit note; frame 1; end
on bumped: say 2; sound crunch; end

name: Dandelion Puff
script:
on tick every 12:
  frame 1 + rand(3)
end
on world breeze: float 20; burst puff; end
on poke: say 1; emit puff; end

name: Acorn Armchair
script:
on near moss:
  if time == night then say 2; emit zzz else say 1 end
end
on poke: emit heart; end

name: Snoozing Fern
script:
on time night: frame 2; emit zzz; end
on time day: frame 1; end
on berry: drop; end
on poke: say 1; end

name: Jam Ferret
script:
on berry: seek food; eat; say 1; end
on poke: say 2; hop 10; end
on tick every 40:
  if fed > 5 and rand(3) == 0 then say 3; emit heart end
end

name: Copper Kettle
script:
on hour 16: sound fizz; burst puff; frame 2; say 1; end
on poke: sound whoosh; emit puff; say 2; end
on time night: frame 1; end

name: Moth Lamp
script:
on time night: glow on; fly; end
on time dawn: glow off; home; end
on poke: frame 2; say 1; end

name: Bubble Fish
script:
on weather rainy: float 16; say 1; burst sparkle; end
on tick every 30:
  if rand(5) == 0 then frame 1 + rand(2); emit puff end
end
on poke: sound plop; say 2; end

name: Mushroom Stool
script:
on bumped: hop 6; sound boing; end
on time dawn: emit puff; end
on poke: say 1; emit heart; end

name: Clock Tulip
script:
on hour:
  frame 1 + hour % 3; sound clock
  if hour == 12 then say 1; burst sparkle end
end
on poke: say 2; end

name: Tin Mouse
script:
on tick every 16:
  if rand(3) == 0 then walk to anywhere; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on world ants: seek food; say 1; end
on poke: sound clock; hop 4; say 2; end

name: Gumdrop Rock
script:
on near critter:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then frame 2; say 1 end
end
on tick every 60: if rand(6) == 0 then emit sparkle end; end
on poke: frame 1; burst sparkle; end

name: Raindrop Mobile
script:
on weather:
  if weather == rainy then frame 2; sound splash; say 1
  elif weather == sunny then frame 3; emit sparkle
  else frame 1 end
end
on poke: sound tune; say 2; end

name: Lantern Jelly
script:
on world dark: glow on; say 1; float 10; end
on time night: glow on; frame 2; end
on time day: glow off; frame 1; end
on poke: glow toggle; say 2; end

name: Thimble Bed
script:
on time night: frame 2; emit zzz; end
on time dawn: frame 1; say 1; end
on near moss:
  if time == night then emit zzz; say 2 end
end

name: Sugar Thistle
script:
on berry: mem[0] += 1; frame 1 + mem[0] % 3; end
on world bloom: burst heart; say 1; end
on poke: emit sparkle; end

name: Puddle Frog
script:
on weather rainy: walk to water; say 1; sound splash; end
on tick every 24:
  if rand(4) == 0 then hop 10; frame 1 + rand(2); sound chirp end
end
on world leak: walk to water; say 2; end
on poke: say 3; hop 16; end

name: Snow Globe
script:
on weather snowy: frame 2; burst sparkle; say 1; end
on time night: emit sparkle; end
on bumped: shake; say 2; end
on poke: emit sparkle; frame 1 + rand(2); end

name: Cuckoo Clock
script:
on hour:
  frame 2; sound chirp; say 1
  wait 8; frame 1
end
on poke: sound clock; end

name: Wishing Seed
script:
on new:
  if has(newtraits, shiny) then say 1; burst sparkle; frame 2 else emit heart end
end
on time dawn: frame 1; float; end
on poke: float 12; say 2; end

name: Driftwood Bench
script:
on world visitor: say 1; emit heart; end
on near snail:
  if sulking then nudge; emit heart end
end
on time dusk: emit heart; end
on poke: emit puff; end

name: Glowcap Cluster
script:
on time night: glow on; frame 2; end
on time day: glow off; frame 1; end
on world dark: glow on; burst sparkle; say 1; end

name: Velvet Bumblebee
script:
on tick every 20:
  if rand(3) == 0 then seek plant; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on world bloom: seek plant; say 1; burst heart; end
on poke: sound chirp; say 2; end

name: Tiny Gong
script:
on shipped: sound ding; frame 2; emit note; end
on jam jammed: sound bang; say 1; end
on poke: sound ding; burst note; frame 1; signal 7; end

name: Acorn Birdhouse
script:
on time dawn: fly; sound chirp; say 1; frame 2; end
on time dusk: home; say 2; frame 1; end
on poke:
  if rand(2) == 0 then fly else home end
end

name: Cloud Puff
script:
on weather rainy: frame 2; emit puff; say 1; end
on weather stormy: frame 3; sound bang; shake; end
on weather sunny: frame 1; say 2; end
on time night: emit zzz; end
on poke: float; emit zzz; end

name: Spool Table
script:
on gift: say 1; burst heart; end
on time dawn: emit heart; end
on poke: hop 4; sound plop; end

name: Singing Reed
script:
on world breeze: sound tune; burst note; frame 2; end
on tick every 60:
  if playing and rand(2) == 0 then emit note; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on poke: say 1 + rand(2); end

name: Lint Bunny
script:
on time night: stop; frame 2; emit zzz; end
on time day: frame 1; walk to garden; end
on near critter:
  if has(neartraits, spooky) then hop 12; say 1 end
end
on poke: say 2; emit heart; end

name: Penny Fountain
script:
on shipped: sound coin; burst sparkle; end
on tick every 40:
  if rand(4) == 0 then emit puff; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on poke: sound splash; say 1 + rand(2); end

name: Ghost Sock
script:
on time night: frame 2; say 1; end
on time dawn: frame 1; end
on world dark: sound whoosh; say 2; end
on poke: flip; end

name: Comet Marble
script:
on hour 0: burst sparkle; sound fizz; say 1; end
on tick every 80:
  if rand(3) == 0 then glow toggle; frame 1 + rand(2) end
end
on poke: float 24; emit sparkle; end

name: Matchbox Dresser
script:
on poke:
  mem[0] += 1
  frame 1 + mem[0] % 2; say 1 + mem[0] % 2
end
on world visitor: frame 2; say 2; end
on time night: frame 1; emit zzz; end

name: Belt Ivy
script:
on jam jammed: frame 2; say 1; end
on jam fixed: frame 1; boost 10; say 2; end
on tick every 100: if rand(4) == 0 then emit heart end; end
on poke: emit heart; end

name: Brass Courier Beetle
script:
on jam jammed: walk to works; say 1; end
on shipped: walk to dock; emit sparkle; frame 2; end
on tick every 50: if rand(4) == 0 then frame 1 end; end
on poke: throw; say 2; end

name: Sleepy Stone
script:
on tick every 200:
  if rand(2) == 0 then emit zzz end
end
on bumped: frame 2; say 1; wait 20; frame 1; end
on poke: frame 2; say 1; end

name: Berry Basket
script:
on berry:
  mem[0] += 1
  if mem[0] > 2 then mem[0] = 0 end
  frame 1 + mem[0]
end
on near critter:
  if has(neartraits, wild) then say 1 end
end
on poke: say 2; emit heart; end

name: Paper Lantern Fish
script:
on time dusk: glow on; frame 2; say 1; end
on time dawn: glow off; frame 1; end
on signal 7: float 16; burst note; end
on poke: signal 7; say 2; end
